title: feat(scenarios): skill-evals --triggers-only runs the selected bundles' trigger cases alone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_
Fixes #35705
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：内部技能评测工具新增「只跑触发用例」模式，六个元数据技能包的一轮从约 354 次对话降到 42 次。
- 为什么做：给「技能描述改动是否让技能在该加载时加载」的测量省下约九成订阅轮次，前后两轮从约 700 次降到约 84 次。
- 出错会怎样：只影响维护者跑评测时选哪些用例、怎么汇总，不改任何对外发布的技能内容，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --triggers-only` selects only the `should_trigger` cases of the selected bundles, on the with-skill arm. It reuses the existing selection (`selectBundles`, one path with a `triggersOnly` argument), plan (`planRound`, which already runs a trigger case on the with-skill arm only) and summary (`summariseRound` / `renderSummaryMarkdown`); no second path.

- **Selection** (`cases.ts`): the pool narrows to trigger cases before the existing `--skills` checks, so a bundle named in `--skills` with no trigger case is refused by name, and a whole-catalog selection with no trigger case at all is refused.
- **Flags** (`cli.ts`): refused beside `--regrade` (a regrade re-draws a round at the scope it ran) and beside `--self-test` (it runs its own fixtures). Works with `--dry-run`, which prints the reduced plan plus how many behaviour cases of those bundles were left out, and with `--skills-from VERSION`.
- **Record and summary**: `round.json` records `scope.arms: ["with-skill"]` and `scope.triggersOnly: true`; `--regrade` reads that and keeps the scope, so the behaviour cases are not listed as `added`. The summary title says `trigger cases × the with-skill arm`, and a trigger-only round renders the trigger section alone (no empty per-bundle and per-case tables); the stdout excerpt follows.
- **Self-test**: two rows (floor 30 to 32): trigger cases kept on the with-skill arm and behaviour cases dropped; and the refusals (beside `--regrade`, beside `--self-test`, on a bundle with no trigger case), with the flag accepted beside `--skills-from` and `--dry-run`.
- **README**: the `skill-evals` section gains the command line and a `--triggers-only` bullet. Changeset: `@objectstack/scenarios` patch (the package publishes, and its `README.md` is in `files[]`).

Net-added lines, whole PR: +143 / -38 = 105 (budget 150).

## Tests

- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/skill-evals/skill-evals.test.ts`: one new case runs a trigger-only round through `executeRound` with a stub turn, asserts both turns are with-skill, that the summary renders the trigger section only, and that `regradeRound` on a `triggersOnly` round adds no behaviour case and keeps the title.
- Self-test rows above.

## Acceptance notes

- `--skills-from 18.5.0 --triggers-only` is refused: that published version predates trigger cases, so the selection is empty (`no bundle under ... has a trigger case`). `--skills-from 18.6.0` plans the same 42 turns (138 behaviour cases left out there), which is the "before" leg the card asks for.
- Without `--skills`, `--triggers-only` keeps every bundle that has a trigger case and leaves out those without one; the refusal fires only when none has one. The round title then reads `all bundles`.
- A `round.json` written before this change has no `scope.triggersOnly` and regrades exactly as before.
- The test file `packages/qa/scenarios/test/skill-evals/skill-evals.test.ts` is outside the claim's declared file surface (`src/skill-evals/*` and the README); it is the package's existing suite for this runner.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cli.ts`: the two refusals in `parseSkillEvalArgs`, the `scope.triggersOnly` record, and the regrade filter in `regradeRound`.
2. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts`: `selectBundles`.
3. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/summary.ts`: the branch that drops the behaviour tables.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --skills objectstack-data,objectstack-ui,objectstack-automation,objectstack-formula,objectstack-i18n,objectstack-query --triggers-only --dry-run` prints the plan line below and makes no model call.

All local readings at head `2ea2c4fe71` (feature commit `0a97625509` plus a merge of `origin/main` at `cceb5c626d`).

<details><summary>Dry-run plan (the card's Done-when)</summary>

```text
42 trigger case(s) × the with-skill arm, × 1 = 42 turn(s), 2 at once
--triggers-only: 156 behaviour case(s) of these bundles left out
trigger cases: 30 should load the bundle, 12 should not
```

Without the flag the same bundles plan `156 behaviour case(s) × 2 arms + 42 trigger case(s) × the with-skill arm, × 1 = 354 turn(s)`.
</details>

<details><summary>Self-test</summary>

```text
✓ select: --triggers-only keeps the trigger cases on the with-skill arm and drops the behaviour cases
✓ flags: --triggers-only beside --regrade or --self-test, or on a bundle with no trigger case → REFUSED

✓ skill-evals self-test: 32 rows pass.
```

Refusal messages as the CLI prints them:

```text
--triggers-only cannot narrow --self-test: the self-test runs its own fixtures, never a selection of cases
--triggers-only cannot narrow --regrade: a regrade re-draws the recorded round at the scope it ran, so a --triggers-only round regrades as one without the flag
```
</details>

<details><summary>Package checks</summary>

```text
pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios run typecheck   -> exit 0 (tsconfig includes test/**, so the new test is type-checked)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2   -> Test Files 40 passed (40), Tests 1202 passed (1202)
eslint --no-inline-config on the 5 changed .ts files   -> exit 0, no findings
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands   -> 62 commands, each run, each exit 0
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran   -> 62 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)
node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/area-a4A-35705   -> origin/main merges cleanly, VERDICT clean exit 0
```

One-time ablation (not kept): deleting the `scope.triggersOnly` filter in `regradeRound` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 -> 0 on disk) turns the new test red with `expected [ [ 'beta-skill/cases#1' ], +0, 2 ] to deeply equal [ [], +0, 2 ]`; restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

The repo-wide lint run, `test:repo` and the type-check lanes are CI's.
</details>

No model call was made: no real round ran.
